description: This file defines the Context class for the Summernote rich text editor, managing layout, modules, event handling, and editor state.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Main class managing the Summernote editor's layout, modules, and event lifecycle.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Context with a jQuery note element and options, then calls initialize.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Creates layout and initializes modules and resources.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys modules, removes layout, and cleans up.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Reinitializes the editor, preserving disabled state.

methods.name: _initialize
methods.description: Adds buttons and modules, then initializes modules.

methods.name: _destroy
methods.description: Destroys modules and triggers destroy event.

methods.name: code
methods.description: Gets or sets the HTML content of the editor.

methods.name: isDisabled
methods.description: Checks if the editor is disabled.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables editing and deactivates codeview if active.

methods.name: initializeModule
methods.description: Initializes a specific module if applicable.

methods.name: memo
methods.description: Stores or retrieves a memo object.

methods.name: removeMemo
methods.description: Removes and destroys a memo object.

methods.name: createInvokeHandlerAndUpdateState
methods.description: Creates a handler that invokes a namespace and updates button styles.

methods.name: createInvokeHandler
methods.description: Creates a handler that invokes a namespace with a value.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Invokes a method or function within modules or the Context itself.
